bios.note: Final firmware Dell shipped for the XPS 8700; no further updates expected
bios.ac_power_restoration_reason: Auto-recovery after power outages — important for always-on hub role. Set after a Detroit outage took the server offline for two days.
bios.console_resolution_note: UEFI firmware ceiling — kernel cannot override the POST framebuffer in OS. See issue #191.

disks.device_note: Kernel name is NOT stable — the internal Realtek card reader's four slots also enumerate as sdX. It was sdg1 before 2026-09-27 and sdc1 on 2026-10-14. fstab mounts by label; identify the drive by label/UUID/model, never by sdX. See #1064.
disks.model: WD easystore 2625 (disk WDC WD10SDRW-11A0XS0, serial WD-WXA1A79HZ5T7), 2.5in 5400rpm, USB bus-powered
disks.size_note: 916 GB is the ext4 filesystem size as df reports it; the raw disk is 1.0 TB / 931.5 GiB
disks.connection: Must be on a USB 3 port (5 Gb/s, 900 mA). On a USB 2.0 port (500 mA) it twice failed to spin up after a power cycle (2026-09-27, 2026-10-14): it enumerated at 0 bytes and every backup failed for 17 days (#1063, #1064).
disks.fstab_options: defaults,nofail — boot continues silently if the drive is absent

hosts.hardware: Framework Desktop (AMD Ryzen AI Max 300 Series)
